Of course! The phone number I’m using is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

4. If data speeds remain slow, run a speed test with “run_speed_test” and share the result so I can guide you further.

3. After resetting APNs, reboot your device (use reboot_device).  
4. Once it’s back up, try the speed test again (run_speed_test) and let me know the outcome.

1. Check Data Saver:

After you’ve done both, reboot your device again, then run run_speed_test one more time and share the result. This will tell us whether anything on the phone itself is still limiting your throughput.
